en.title: Time expressions for the past
en.summary: Time expressions place an action in the past.

paragraphs: A time expression tells when an action happened or how long it lasted. In the past, certain expressions go with the simple past, others with the present perfect, so a good choice of expression helps you choose the tense.

items: We have known each other **for years**.

blocks.html:
ExpressionUsed withExample
yesterday, last week, in 2010simple pastWe moved last year.
agosimple pastShe left an hour ago.
for, sincepresent perfectI have lived here for five years.
just, already, yetpresent perfectHas he arrived yet?
ever, neverpresent perfectI've never seen it.
when, while, aspast tensesWhile I was out, it rained.

paragraphs: For gives a length of time. Since gives the starting point. Ago counts back from now. They have different tenses and meanings.

blocks.html:
WordExample
forI lived there for three years. (finished) / I have lived here for three years. (still)
sinceI have lived here since 2020.
agoI moved here three years ago.

paragraphs: Time expressions usually come at the end of the sentence or at the beginning. Adverbs such as already, just and never go before the main verb. With a beginning expression, a comma often follows: Last year, we moved.

items: Wrong: **I have seen him last week.** Right: **I saw him last week.**
Wrong: **She lives here since 2018.** Right: **She has lived here since 2018.**
Wrong: **I met him since three years.** Right: **I met him three years ago.**

ro.title: Expresii de timp pentru trecut
ro.summary: Expresiile de timp arată momentul în care s-a petrecut o acțiune din trecut.

paragraphs: Expresiile de timp arată când s-a întâmplat o acțiune din trecut. Ele te ajută să alegi forma corectă a verbului. Folosim aceste expresii foarte des împreună cu timpul perfect compus.
Poți pune expresia de timp la începutul sau la sfârșitul propoziției. Cuvântul „acum” arată timpul scurs de la acea acțiune. Adjectivul „trecut” își schimbă forma după genul substantivului.

blocks.html:
ExpresieSensExemplu
ieriîn ziua precedentăAm sosit ieri.
acum o orăcu o oră în urmăTrenul a plecat acum o oră.
săptămâna trecutăîn săptămâna precedentă (feminin)Am lucrat mult săptămâna trecută.
anul trecutîn anul precedent (neutru)Am vizitat Roma anul trecut.
